summary: Validated both small product wins in iteration_32: (1) 'View Covers' affordance on BattleArena stage cards and (2) IndexedDB persistence of uploaded stems + AI beats in PersonalStudio. All 11 in-scope scenarios PASS. 0 page errors, 0 same-key warnings, 0 new regressions versus iteration_31 baseline.

test_results_detail.F1.view_covers_button_renders_per_card: PASS — 13 battle-cards present, 13 corresponding [data-testid^='view-covers-'] buttons. 1:1 mapping verified via DOM query.
test_results_detail.F1.click_view_covers_opens_battle_detail: PASS — Clicking view-covers-{id} renders data-testid='battle-detail'. data-testid='gamer-stage' was NOT present after click, confirming stopPropagation works and the row's onClick was suppressed.
test_results_detail.F1.detail_back_btn_returns_to_arena: PASS — Clicking detail-back-btn restores data-testid='battle-arena' (stage list).
test_results_detail.F1.row_body_click_still_opens_stage: PASS — Clicking the card body (left of the View Covers pill at offset x=30) navigates to data-testid='gamer-stage'. Both affordances coexist.
test_results_detail.F1.empty_battles_no_regression: NOT DIRECTLY EXERCISED — DB has 13 seeded battles. Code-reviewed the JSX path: the 'empty-battles' branch is unchanged and only renders when battles.length===0; new view-covers button is inside the battles.map() loop and cannot affect the empty branch.
test_results_detail.F2.tools_panel_visible_creator_record: PASS — studio-tools-panel visible at 1280x900 in creator lane on nav-record (StadiumStudio).
test_results_detail.F2.upload_stem_adds_entry: PASS — setInputFiles({name:'test_stem.mp3', mimeType:'audio/mpeg', buffer:<dummy>}) on stem-file-input results in a new stem-{id} entry in stem-list with stem-play-{id} and stem-remove-{id}. Toast 'stem added' fires.
test_results_detail.F2.upload_persists_in_indexeddb: PASS — After upload, IDB 'pp_personal_studio'.stems contains 1 record (name='test_stem.mp3', kind='upload', blob is a real Blob).
test_results_detail.F2.stem_survives_reload: PASS — page.reload() + navigate back to nav-record, the same stem-{id} re-appears (hydrated from IDB; blob URL is re-created via URL.createObjectURL on mount).
test_results_detail.F2.remove_deletes_from_indexeddb: PASS — Clicking stem-remove-{id} empties the IDB store (count=0). After reload, the stem does NOT reappear — list is empty.
test_results_detail.F2.ai_beat_generates_and_persists: PASS — Clicking ai-beat-generate adds a stem-beat-{ts} entry to stem-list within ~3-10s. IDB stores it as kind='beat' with a ~529 KB Blob. After reload, stem-beat-{ts} is hydrated and stem-play-{id} click is accepted (blob URL re-created from the persisted Blob).
test_results_detail.regression.creator_nav_tabs: PASS — nav-home→home-page, nav-connect→connect-heading, nav-studio→koala-studio, nav-record→stadium-studio, nav-profile→social-profile all transitioned correctly.
test_results_detail.regression.console_errors: 0 page errors, 0 same-key warnings. Pre-existing hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still emitted (same as iteration_31 baseline, not introduced by this change).
test_results_detail.regression.empty_idb_on_first_load: PASS — After deleteDatabase('pp_personal_studio'), stem-list is empty on fresh load (no spurious hydration).

critical_code_review_comments: stemStore.js is a clean, dependency-free IDB wrapper (78 lines). DB versioning is in place. One minor: putStem/listStems/removeStem/clearStems each call openDB() per invocation, opening a fresh connection each time. Acceptable at current scale (one tab, low write rate) but a singleton DB promise would be marginally more efficient.

stemStore.dataUrlToBlob handles both data: and blob: URLs by relying on fetch() — clean. Returns null for http(s) URLs which would silently skip persistence for any future server-hosted beat URL. Consider logging a console.warn in that branch so persistence misses are visible during development.

StadiumStudio.onFileChange: persistence is fire-and-forget (.catch(console.warn)). Acceptable, but the toast.success('N stems added') fires regardless of IDB success — a user could see the toast but lose the stem on reload if the put fails. Low-prio: surface IDB failures as a toast.error.

StadiumStudio hydration useEffect: depends on [] (mount-only) and sorts by createdAt ascending — correct. It does NOT revoke the blob URLs created for hydrated entries on unmount because the existing cleanup useEffect runs once on mount and captures the original (empty) `stems` closure; hydrated stems are never URL.revokeObjectURL'd. Minor memory leak on tab close; not a functional bug. Recommend moving the cleanup to a ref-based pattern that always sees the latest stems list.

BattleStageListView.view-covers-{id} button has solid stopPropagation, an accessible title attribute, and a distinct color (green pill vs orange enter chevron). The 8px font ('text-[8px]') is intentional for the compact card; tested clickable at 1280x900 — readable but borderline on smaller mobile widths. Consider 9-10px if mobile UX is reviewed.

BattleArena.openBattleDetail correctly loads covers + transitions view='detail'. Confirmed via test: stopPropagation prevents the row onClick → openBattle path from firing simultaneously. detail-back-btn round-trips cleanly.
Pre-existing hydration warning '<span> in <option>' from iteration_31 baseline is still emitted — out of scope for this iteration but should be tracked separately.
seed_data_creation: None — DB already has 13 active battles. IDB was wiped via deleteDatabase('pp_personal_studio') at start of stem tests to ensure a clean baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_32 adds: (a) view-covers-{battle.id} pill button on each battle-card-{id} row that opens battle-detail (NOT gamer-stage); (b) IndexedDB-backed stem persistence via /app/frontend/src/services/stemStore.js (DB 'pp_personal_studio', store 'stems'). To inspect/wipe IDB in Playwright: indexedDB.deleteDatabase('pp_personal_studio'). For stem-upload tests, use setInputFiles({name,mimeType:'audio/mpeg',buffer:<small Buffer>}) — the dummy MPEG header is accepted because PersonalStudio doesn't decode-validate before storing. AI beat generation hits /api/studio/beat/generate and returns a data:audio/wav URL (~529KB blob persisted as kind='beat'). The pre-existing hydration warning '<span> in <option>' is from iteration_31 baseline — unrelated.
